reference_sql:
WITH promo_products AS (
  SELECT promo_id, COUNT(*) AS n_products
  FROM promotion_products
  GROUP BY promo_id
),
promo_lines AS (
  SELECT ol.promo_id,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_eur,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur - ol.quantity * p.unit_cost_eur) AS margin_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ol.promo_id
)
SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.promo_type, pr.discount_pct,
       COALESCE(pp.n_products, 0) AS n_products,
       COALESCE(pl.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(pl.margin_eur, 0) AS margin_eur
FROM promotions AS pr
LEFT JOIN promo_products AS pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
LEFT JOIN promo_lines AS pl ON pl.promo_id = pr.promo_id
WHERE pr.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
ORDER BY pr.discount_pct DESC, pr.promo_code

WITH promo_products AS (
  SELECT promo_id, COUNT(product_id) AS n_products
  FROM promotion_products
  GROUP BY promo_id
),
promo_lines AS (
  SELECT ol.promo_id,
         SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
         SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS margin_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN sales AS s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ol.promo_id
)
SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.promo_type, pr.discount_pct,
       COALESCE(pp.n_products, 0) AS n_products,
       COALESCE(pl.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(pl.margin_eur, 0) AS margin_eur
FROM promotions AS pr
LEFT JOIN promo_products AS pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
LEFT JOIN promo_lines AS pl ON pl.promo_id = pr.promo_id
WHERE pr.start_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND pr.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
ORDER BY pr.discount_pct DESC, pr.promo_code

other_way.sql:
SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.promo_type, pr.discount_pct,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pp.product_id) AS n_products,
       COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur), 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur - ol.quantity * p.unit_cost_eur), 0) AS margin_eur
FROM promotions AS pr
LEFT JOIN promotion_products AS pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
LEFT JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.promo_id = pp.promo_id AND ol.product_id = pp.product_id
LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE pr.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY pr.promo_code, pr.promo_type, pr.discount_pct
ORDER BY pr.discount_pct DESC, pr.promo_code
other_way.tradeoff: One query joining lines on promo_id and product_id also avoids repeats, but drops a line whose product the promotion does not list.

solver.query:
SELECT p.promo_code, p.promo_type, p.discount_pct,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion_products pp WHERE pp.promo_id = p.promo_id) AS n_products,
       COALESCE(l.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(l.margin_eur, 0) AS margin_eur
FROM promotions p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ol.promo_id,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_eur,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur - ol.quantity * pr.unit_cost_eur) AS margin_eur
  FROM order_lines ol JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ol.promo_id
) l ON l.promo_id = p.promo_id
WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
ORDER BY p.discount_pct DESC, p.promo_code ASC
